# Fixture provenance

`v1-scene.otoon` was generated by OPEN-TOON's original `--render-demo` command,
using its procedural bouncing-ball scene. It contains no imported artwork or
private data. Its database schema and document version are both 1. Keep this
file unchanged: migration tests must exercise a file from the old application,
not a legacy document synthesized by the current serializer.

Original fixture and code: GPL-3.0-or-later.

The [Harmony Moment reference input](harmony-moment/README.md) is separately
generated from original artwork code; it is a target fixture, not a legacy project.
